hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *serverless/*.py) (cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && uv run ruff format "$f" && uv run ruff check --select I --fix "$f") >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *pyproject.toml|*uv.lock) echo 'Reminder: Python deps changed - run `make requirements` to refresh requirements.txt for Vercel.' ;; esac; exit 0
